title: New multi-modeling approach can predict rice yield in agrivoltaics

title: U.S. energy storage prices to drop through 2030, but trade risks and supply gaps threaten potential savings
content: A report from Intertek CEA explores how U.S. battery storage price declines face policy headwinds as trade restrictions and domestic supply bottlenecks shape market access through 2030.

title: New SEIA white paper outlines pathways for distributed resources to meet grid needs
content: The report, prepared by Current Energy Group, outlines a distributed capacity procurement framework designed to help state regulators and utilities integrate distributed solar and storage as cost-effective alternatives to traditional grid infrastructure.

title: Clean energy project cancellations outpace new U.S. investments by $8.2 billion, E2 finds
content: New figures from E2 show $86.6 billion in canceled or reduced clean energy investments since 2025, despite billions in new generation and manufacturing announcements, including Tesla's planned Texas solar factory.

title: INA Solar, Caelux target perovskite-silicon tandem module production by 2028
content: INA Solar and US-based Caelux have signed a five-year agreement to commercialize 3 GW of perovskite-TOPCon hybrid-tandem solar modules in India, targeting efficiencies of up to 29% by 2028. The deal expands Caelux’s partnerships with Indian module manufacturers to scale next-generation solar technology.
